## What it checks (sampled describe/it titles)

- Portal and milestone mounted routes
- manages portal tokens and serves a quote view through the mounted public route
- serves order milestones, approved quality docs, and customer messages through the public portal
- creates, lists, escalates, and scores internal portal service cases
- fails closed for invalid tokens, missing scope, and missing payloads
- requires PRISM auth for internal portal routes
